name: rls-probe
description: Offline Row Level Security audit for Supabase: loads your migrations or schema dump into a local sandbox Postgres, runs static rules plus executed access probes (anon, user A, user B), and writes a ranked report, SARIF and a draft fix. No keys, no live project.

scripts.test: node --test test/audit.test.js test/data-safety.test.js test/locations.test.js test/formats.test.js test/sarif.test.js test/ci.test.js test/cli.test.js test/restrictive.test.js
